search.document: query SearchListings($where: WhereInput, $sort: SortInput, $size: Int, $from: Int) { Web { find(where: $where, sort: $sort, size: $size, from: $from) { listings { id title price area rooms category type city district path } } } }

get.document: query GetListing($id: Int!) { Web { listing(id: $id) { id title price area rooms category type city district path } } }
